capabilities: Build vector embeddings for all vault notes via Ollama
Find notes similar to selected text with cosine similarity
Configure similarity threshold and chunking strategy
Update vectors automatically on file changes
Log API calls and processing to the developer console
extras: Requires Ollama installed locally with the nomic-embed-text model (~500MB) and port 11434 available; README includes system requirements and troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches keywords, so notes about the same topic but phrased differently cannot be found.

relations.evidence: This plugin adds semantic search capabilities to Obsidian using Ollama's embedding API.

summary: Semantic search plugin that finds notes similar to selected text using Ollama-generated vector embeddings and cosine similarity.
